## Ebola disease, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2026

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- Bundibugyo virus. Declared on 15 May 2026
- McCabe et al. estimated outbreak size from exports to Uganda and from
  deaths. We replicated it the next day
- Then a joint model of every stream in the daily situation reports
- Each stream alone gives a different size
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](figures/agents-bvd-streams.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="Posterior densities of cumulative infections, one curve per data
stream, cases, confirmed, deaths and exports, and one for the joint fit,
which sits inside the spread of the single-stream fits."}

::: {.attribution}
McCabe et al. 2026, Imperial College London,
[doi:10.25560/130007](https://doi.org/10.25560/130007) ·
[BVDOutbreakSize][bvd-repo], data to 7 June 2026
:::
